description: Join Our Friendly and Supportive Team at Seaford Medical Practice We are looking for an enthusiastic Receptionist to join our dedicated team at Seaford Medical Practice. This is an excellent opportunity to become part of a welcoming, supportive, and patient-focused practice that is committed to providing high-quality healthcare. At Seaford Medical Practice, we pride ourselves on delivering compassionate and patient focused care. Our reception team plays a vital role in ensuring patients receive a positive experience. You will be joining a friendly and experienced reception team that works closely together to support one another and provide an excellent service. We value teamwork, professionalism, and a caring approach to both patients and colleagues. As a training practice, we are committed to supporting staff development and we encourage training and personal development to help our staff build their skills and confidence. Our practice benefits from a wide-ranging multidisciplinary team, including GPs, Practice Nurses, Advanced Clinical Practitioners (ACPs), First Contact Practitioners (FCPs), Social Prescribers, Healthcare Assistants, Pharmacists, and other healthcare professionals. Working alongside such a diverse team enables us to provide comprehensive care and support to our patients. If you are organised, approachable, enjoy helping people, and would like to work in a busy and rewarding healthcare environment, we would love to hear from you. Reception duties to include but not limited to: Making and cancelling appointments on the front desk and over the telephone, which includes Care Navigating the patients to the most appropriate services. Dealing with all patients enquiries Taking medical and admin requests via the patient triage accurx system. Working in our acute team hub, assigning and booking triage requests Recording requests for home visits Issuing repeat prescriptions Scanning letters into patient records and work flowing to the appropriate GP/Department Sorting mail Registering Temporary/Permanent residents Accepting and checking registration forms for new patients Charging patients for non-NHS work, providing an invoice and taking payment. Additional Duties: Assisting the Reception Manager in any of their duties when required. Charging patients for non-NHS work, providing an invoice and taking payment Assisting the reception manager in any of their duties when required Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. title: Receptionist/Telephonist
description: Would you like to make a difference and use your people skills to support the provision of mental health services in the community? We are looking for a friendly, enthusiastic and self-motivated individual to join our busy Specialist Adults Community Mental Health Team, based at Chapel Street Clinic, Chichester. As well as Chichester, our services cover care in the community for Bognor, Midhurst and the surrounding areas. There is a requirement for occasional cross-cover of our reception at the Bedale Centre in Bognor Regis. The post holder will provide front of house services in the form of reception duties, which will alternate on a weekly basis with switchboard duties. There is also a requirement to support the wider admin team with general administrative duties, ensuring plenty of variety. Effective communication skills and a commitment to caring for patients in the community are required for this rewarding role. The role supports service users and a multi-disciplinary team with telephonist and reception duties including: Answering and transferring telephone calls. Taking comprehensive messages and relaying them verbally where necessary. Typing emailed messages to professionals. Updating patients' notes where appropriate. Welcoming patients, visitors and carers to sites. Opening and directing incoming post. Booking rooms for outpatient appointments and meetings. Preparing and typing clinic sheets and weekly staff rotas. Uploading documents to our patient information system. Photocopying and collating. Occasional cross-cover of our reception at the Bedale Centre in Bognor Regis. Ideally you will have: A good standard of secondary education. Experience of working with the public in a patient facing or customer service role. Experience of working in a team. Experience with Outlook, Word and preferably with patient/customer IT administration systems. Excellent and accurate keyboard skills. An eye for detail. An ability to multi-task and remain calm under pressure. You will require excellent interpersonal skills for effective communication with service users and the multi-disciplinary team, which consists of psychiatrists, nurses, psychologists, managers, mental health practitioners and support workers. A background within healthcare services would be an advantage, but other reception or customer facing experience will be considered. This is a full time role, 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Please read Job Description and Person Specification attached for more details. For any questions, please contact Nina McLagan, Admin Team Lead (see contact details below).

title: MSK Therapies - Booking Clerk
description: We are looking for a friendly and approachable individual to work as a Booking Clerk within our Physiotherapy Administration Team. This post will be based at Eastbourne DGH although the successful applicant will also be required to cover reception duties at our community sites at within East Sussex. You will need to work on a shift pattern which may involve some 7:30 am starts and 5:30 pm finishes. The role will involve supporting our reception desks across Sussex; dealing with patient and clinical queries by phone and email, and processing referrals in our Central Booking Office, ensuring the best possible care. Please refer to the job description attached. If you have any questions about this position please do not hesitate to contact us.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Beaconsfield Medical Practice is looking to recruit an enthusiastic, professional and patient-focused Medical Receptionist to join our busy and supportive team. We are a well-established GP practice serving a patient population of just under 14,000 patients in the Preston Park area of Brighton. As a member practice within a successful and established Primary Care Network (PCN), we are committed to delivering high-quality, accessible healthcare to our local community. The successful candidate will become part of a large multidisciplinary team, working alongside GPs, nurses, pharmacists, healthcare assistants, administrative staff, secretaries and management colleagues. This is an excellent opportunity for an individual who enjoys working with people, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is committed to providing outstanding customer service and patient care. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing a welcoming and efficient reception service while supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. Key responsibilities include: Acting as the first point of contact for patients, visitors, and healthcare professionals. Managing incoming telephone calls and patient enquiries. Supporting the booking and management of appointments through our System Connect total triage model. Processing appointment requests and directing patients to the most appropriate service. Supporting new patients with registrations Assisting with maintaining accurate patient records. Processing prescriptions and supporting administrative workflows where appropriate. Handling confidential information in accordance with GDPR and NHS information governance requirements. Working collaboratively with colleagues to provide an efficient and effective patient service. Main Duties To greet patients at the front desk (Ground Floor, 3rd & 4th Floors) and manage all queries effectively whilst maintaining patient confidentiality. Manage all patient enquiries courteously via telephone and in person Support patients to access & complete the online appointment request forms for GP appointments Support triaging GP to process GP appointment requests efficiently signposting patient to the most appropriate appointment Book appointments for Practice nurse, HCAs and Phlebotomist Process any administrative tasks associated with Role Action incoming tasks via the clinical system Support new patients to register with the practice Process repeat prescription requests in accordance with Practice guidelines Monitor incoming emails to the practice email account Ensure that all messages/information is correctly relayed and in a timely manner Clear rooms after surgeries Check waiting area tidy Maintain confidentiality at all times Assist in maintaining high levels of infection control To have a thorough knowledge of all Practice procedures/adhere to protocol Maintain up to date knowledge of other patient services i.e. extended access, pharmacy first and urgent treatment centres Maintain up to date knowledge of NHS App and other patient online services Other Duties Provide holiday/sickness cover for reception Attend training courses and meetings as required to ensure you have the skills and information to carry out the role effectively Assist Admin team with Quality Outcome Framework (QOF)

title: GP Receptionist
description: This role is ideal for someone who will thrive in a role that combines customer service skills with a caring approach to problem solving, strong IT skills and an enjoyment of working efficiently. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate their natural interest in the industry and their aptitude for the role. The role is available for between 10 and 25 hours per week. Our usual shift times are 8am - 1pm and 130pm - 630pm, Monday to Friday. Candidates for this vacancy will ideally be able to work on some or all of Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays. Our assessment process has three stages: Shortlisting, Interview, Shadowing on site Then, for successful candidates, the first 4 weeks will be focused on shadowing and training, including time to get to know all areas of the practice. Following successful completion of this initial training period, overtime will be available from time to time, to help cover annual leave and training days. To be the face of Tangmere Medical Centre, often a patients first contact point when they are in need of assistance. To deliver a consistently high standard of professional customer service to all patients both in person and over the phone. To efficiently assess and arrange the optimal follow up for every patient contact, managing the necessary mix of information gathering, appointment booking, telephone follow up and other admin for patient care. To contribute to the team effectiveness through a pro-active approach to work and a flexible work pattern covering holiday and training days. Please see the full job description for the principal duties, skills and personal responsibilities of the role. title: Ward Administrator
description: We are looking for an experienced, enthusiastic and well-organised Ward Administrator to join our team on a 19-bedded Acute Mental Health Ward. You will be required to work to a high standard of accuracy, demonstrate excellent organisational skills, and show initiative in planning and prioritising your own workload in a way that actively supports the smooth running of the ward. This is a part-time job share opportunity, working Monday to Wednesday, alongside another Ward Administrator who works Thursday and Friday. Due to the nature of the role, this is an on-site position. Working within a busy, fast paced and sometimes challenging inpatient environment, you will play a pivotal role in supporting ward based services at Langley Green Hospital. The ward office can at times be noisy, and the role requires resilience, flexibility, and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively. Good IT skills are essential, including Outlook, Word, Excel and electronic patient record systems such as SystmOne (training will be provided), alongside strong communication and interpersonal skills to liaise effectively with the multidisciplinary team and handle telephone enquiries professionally and confidentially. You may receive complex calls from patients, carers, and professionals, which must be managed appropriately, so a calm and professional telephone manner is essential. You will receive ongoing support, supervision and training opportunities. Act as first point of contact for the ward, managing reception duties, telephone calls, emails, and general enquiries Maintain accurate and up to date patient records on clinical systems such as SystmOne Undertake a range of administrative duties including scanning, filing, typing, photocopying, and document management Coordinate and schedule meetings, appointments, and ward related activities Support effective communication between clinical staff, patients, carers, and external agencies Order, receive, and monitor stock and supplies for the ward Support data entry, reporting, and information management requirements Ensure confidentiality is maintained in line with Trust policies and data protection requirements Provide flexible administrative support to the wider ward team as required Please refer to the Job Description for further detailed information about the responsibilities, requirements, and expectations of this role.
